messages:
maria: FYI: AcmePayments is seeing token-level latency spikes for their workspace. Dashboard: https://redwood.dash/acme-pay/workspace-latency - spikes line up with kernel changes? cc @alex @sasha
alex: On it. Do we have kernel pick logs for that workspace? Looking for kernel_pick_reason + kv_partition_id.
sasha: I pulled traces: a lot of requests switched to kernel v2-quant-int8 around 11:47. Also KV cache miss rate jumped. snippet: `kernel=v2-quant-int8 kv_miss=0.47`
jay: that rollout was yesterday morning as a canary. Noticed ~2% error bump but not this. Maybe batching heuristic changed?
maria: perf-bot flagged higher p95 token latency. PerfBot: `p95_token_latency +120ms since 2026-03-18T11:45`
perf-bot: Alert: workspace=acme-pay p95_token_latency=420ms (+120ms) kv_miss_rate=0.47. Link: https://alerts/12345
priya: For dashboards: we only show aggregate org metrics. Customer asked for per-workspace token breakdown. We need RBAC so account teams only see their workspace.
alex: Agree. Proposal: add `token_latency_breakdown` panel that filters by workspace_id and shows `kernel_pick_reason` and `kv_partition_id`. We can reuse the per-route KPI view.
sasha: Quick query I ran:
```
SELECT workspace, kernel, kv_partition, avg(token_latency) as p95
FROM token_metrics
WHERE workspace='acme-pay' AND ts>='2026-03-18T11:30'
GROUP BY kernel, kv_partition
ORDER BY p95 DESC
```
jay: Looks like kv_partition 7 is hot; other tenants on same partition? If so maybe noisy neighbor. @ops-bot any rebalancing events?
ops-bot: Rebalance job started 2026-03-18T11:42 for partition 7 -> moved 3 tenants. Job completed 11:50. No errors.
priya: RBAC note: Sensitive metrics currently in infra view. We'll add a 'workspace_admin' role to dashboard perms + `workspace_id` tag-based filters.
maria: Short-term mitigation: pin AcmePayments to kernel v2-legacy (pre-quant) for dedicated route. Alex can you open a flag?
alex: Opened rollout override: `route_override workspace=acme-pay kernel=v2-legacy` — will take effect in ~2min. Rolling back canary for this workspace.
sasha: After override p95 back to baseline in our snapshot: p95=280ms. Will follow up with kernel team to investigate quant kernel memory access pattern with KV partition 7.
maria: :thumbsup: Action items: 1) Alex: override (done). 2) Sasha: deep profile kernel/KV interactions. 3) Priya: RBAC dashboard design. 4) Jay: confirm partition hotness isolation. ETA 24h.
perf-bot: Note: created ticket PERF-789 for regression investigation.
